title: trisetum trinii var. micrantherum
intro: Trisetum trinii var. micrantherum, commonly known as a type of grass, is a plant species in the family Poaceae. It is a perennial grass native to certain regions and has been traditionally used in herbal medicine. The plant is said to offer potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function due to its various therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents present in Trisetum trinii var. micrantherum include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, although more research is needed to confirm its full range of effects.
